project: VARDHANI HIGH-SPECIALIST R3 — GPT-5.6 SOL TEACHER / STUDENT-250 V2
purpose: Test a structurally distinct causal source of intraday edge: SENSEX as a broad-market leader whose unusually strong 15-minute move is already directionally shared by NIFTY, while NIFTY remains behind in magnitude and begins a 5-minute catch-up. Trade in the SENSEX direction only after observable NIFTY catch-up and inverse VIX confirmation.

predecessor_evidence.R3R: VIX-led risk-shock continuation failed the 2023 gate; 2024 remained unopened.
predecessor_evidence.design_inference: Move event authority from VIX and NIFTY to cross-index leadership. Unlike R3O reversion, R3S follows the leader and requires NIFTY already to agree directionally but lag in magnitude before catch-up entry.

signal.adaptive_history: previous 126 completed trading-date observations at the same clock checkpoint only
signal.candidate_direction: sign of SENSEX causal 15-minute return; positive=CE, negative=PE
signal.sensex_impulse_condition: absolute SENSEX causal 15-minute return >= previous-history same-checkpoint Q0.70
signal.nifty_direction_condition: NIFTY causal 15-minute return has the same sign as SENSEX candidate direction and is nonzero
signal.leader_condition: absolute SENSEX causal 15-minute return > absolute NIFTY causal 15-minute return
signal.lead_gap_definition: absolute SENSEX causal 15-minute return minus absolute NIFTY causal 15-minute return
signal.lead_gap_condition: lead gap >= previous-history same-checkpoint Q0.60 of positive lead-gap observations
signal.nifty_catchup_condition: NIFTY causal 5-minute return has candidate direction and absolute value >= previous-history same-checkpoint median absolute NIFTY 5-minute return
signal.vix_confirmation: India VIX causal 5-minute return has opposite sign to candidate direction
signal.session_location_confirmation: CE requires NIFTY session_pos>=0.55; PE requires NIFTY session_pos<=0.45

horizon_router.entry: next genuine same-session minute open after signal

qualification.if_2023_passes: freeze R3S configuration and then and only then open 2024 audit
qualification.if_2023_fails: retire R3S without opening 2024; preregister a structurally distinct R3T before any R3T output

option_gate.data: genuine 2024 full-chain NIFTY option candles from authorized Sep-Oct expiry weeks
